title: Fifth-grade math MCA participation at Meadowview Elementary reached 99% for 2024-25 test
text:
Fifth-grade math MCA participation at Meadowview Elementary reached 99% for 2024-25 test
T. A. Huey
The Minnesota Department of Education reports that fifth-graders at Meadowview Elementary School maintained the second highest participation rate on the mathematics section of the 2024-25 MCA.
A total of 98 out of 305 students who took the math assessment at Meadowview Elementary were in fifth grade.
Results show that 40% of the school’s fifth-grade students met the mathematics proficiency criteria as defined by the MCA standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) are Minnesota’s statewide exams for math, reading, and science, used to evaluate student achievement in relation to the state’s academic requirements and meet legislative mandates. While most students participate in the MCA, the Alt MCA is available for those in special education who qualify under eligibility rules.
Statewide MCA proficiency rates in Minnesota have fallen compared to before the pandemic, Minnesota's Report Card shows. For mathematics, scores are more than 7% lower than in 2019, while reading proficiency is down by nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in mathematics |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 100 | 54% |
| 4th | 107 | 48% |
| 5th | 98 | 40% |
Information in this article was obtained from the Minnesota Department of Education. The source data can be found here.
